jamb-commerce-bank-1466.explanation: It is the responsibility of a business to pay tax as at and when due. Also, complying with the rules and regulations.

jamb-commerce-bank-1467.explanation: A bill of lading is a document that lists the goods being transported from one place to another. It serves as a receipt and a contract between the shipper and the carrier. The bill of lading specifically serves as a comprehensive record of the goods being transported.

jamb-commerce-bank-1468.explanation: The pattern of consumption of consumers in an area must be taken into consideration since it is good to site a warehouse near the consumers.

jamb-commerce-bank-1470.explanation: They develop trade with other towns outside the country or other town within its territory thereby, promoting home and foreign trade.

jamb-commerce-bank-1471.explanation: The functions of trade association includes: - fixing prices for their services or product - provide credit facilities and assistance to members - educate their members on trade activities - settle dispute among members

jamb-commerce-bank-1472.explanation: The consumers can buy varieties of goods from the retailers , hence they are exposed to a wide range of goods.

jamb-commerce-bank-1473.explanation: One of the objective of business is to derive maximum profit. Others include: to provide goods and services that will meet the needs of the consumers, to protect the interest of workers etc.

jamb-commerce-bank-1474.explanation: Dissolution of partnership is coming to an end of a partnership agreement due to the following: - death of a partner - joint decision - insolvency of the business - insanity of a partner - expiration of agreement - bankruptcy of a partner

jamb-commerce-bank-1475.explanation: Market orientation is an approach to business that prioritizes identifying the needs and desires of consumers and creating products and services that satisfy them.

jamb-commerce-bank-1476.explanation: The advantages of division of labour are: - it increase production - development of greater skill - large scale of production - it leads to specialisation

jamb-commerce-bank-1477.explanation: Agency by necessity arises when an emergency situation happens. When somebody who is possession of another person's property has to so something to preserve the property.

jamb-commerce-bank-1478.explanation: A contract is an agreement between two or more parties which is intended by them to have legal backing. The vital thing which turns an agreements into a contract is when the parties intend to be legally bound to carry out their agreements.

jamb-commerce-bank-1479.explanation: An offer is a proposal made by one party (the offeror) to another person (the offeree) that indicates a willingness to enter into a contract.

jamb-commerce-bank-1480.explanation: A cartel is a group of independent market participants who collude with each other in order to improve their profits and dominate the market e.g OPEC

jamb-commerce-bank-1481.explanation: Extractive occupation is concerned with making available raw materials and natural products from land or sea e.g farming, fishing, mining, hunting etc.

jamb-commerce-bank-1482.explanation: A wholesaler is a merchant who purchases goods in large quantity from the manufacturer and sell in small quantities to the retailer. The wholesaler acts as an intermediary between the retailer and the manufacturer.

jamb-commerce-bank-1483.explanation: A cheque is said to be bounced if the cheque is being rejected or dishonoured by the bank. Another name for dishonoured cheque is a bounced cheque.

jamb-commerce-bank-1484.explanation: Marketing encompasses all activities directed at conveying commodities to buyers. This includes selling, delivering, advertising, and more. Therefore, the correct answer is 'marketing'.

jamb-commerce-bank-1485.explanation: A liquidator is a person with the legal authority to act on behalf of a company to sell the company's assets before the company closes in order to generate cash for a variety of reasons including debt repayment.

jamb-commerce-bank-1486.explanation: The net profit is calculated by subtracting the total expenses from the net sales. In this case, the net sales is ₦370,000 and the total expenses (cost of goods sold and rent expenses) is ₦265,000. Therefore, the net profit is ₦370,000 - ₦265,000 = ₦105,000.

jamb-commerce-bank-1487.explanation: Current account holders use cheques to withdraw money from their bank accounts. A cheque is an order to a bank to pay a stated sum from the drawer's account, written on a specially printed form.

jamb-commerce-bank-1488.explanation: The factors are: capital, pricing policy, source of supply, type of goods, terms of trade, experience, advertising, location of the business.

jamb-commerce-bank-1489.explanation: Gross profit is calculated by subtracting the cost of goods sold from net sales. From the given data, Net sales is ₦370,000 and Cost of goods sold is ₦230,000. Therefore, Gross profit = Net sales - Cost of goods sold = ₦370,000 - ₦230,000 = ₦140,000.

jamb-commerce-bank-1490.explanation: A credit sale is a sale in which the customer does not pay in full at the time of purchase, but agrees to pay later. The seller transfers the ownership of goods or services to the customer and expects to receive payment in the future.

jamb-commerce-bank-1491.explanation: Partnership are formed by an association of two to twenty persons. The number of partners involved serves as both merit and demerit to partnership business.

jamb-commerce-bank-1492.explanation: Social responsibility means that individuals and companies must act in the best interests of their environment and society as a whole. It is also known as corporate social responsibilties. Corporate social responsibility is a business model by which companies make a concerted effort to operate in ways that enhance rather than degrade society and the environment.

jamb-commerce-bank-1493.explanation: Counter offer meaning is an offer made in response to a previous offer by the other party. It implies a rejection of the original offer and requires an acceptance of the new terms or there is no contract. Counter offer can be used in different situations, such as when an employee resigns or when a seller negotiates with a buyer.

jamb-commerce-bank-1494.explanation: indemnity insurance is an insurance in which the insurer promises to make the insured party whole again for any covered loss in exchange for premiums the policyholder pays.

jamb-commerce-bank-1495.explanation: Land as a factor of production does not vary in quantity. The total land area of the earth is fixed and cannot be increased or decreased. However, the nature, quality, and cost of land can vary. The nature of land refers to its physical characteristics, the quality refers to its productivity or usefulness for a specific purpose, and the cost refers to the price of acquiring the land.

jamb-commerce-bank-1496.explanation: Money is any item or verifiable record that is generally accepted as payment for goods and services and repayment of debts, such as taxes, in a particular country. Legal tender is any official medium of payment recognized by law that can be used to extinguish a public or private debt, or meet a financial obligation

jamb-commerce-bank-1497.explanation: Some advertisment may be false and misleading as they make exaggerated claims. Also it leads to monopoly and encourages buyers to make unncessary purchase.

jamb-commerce-bank-1499.explanation: The sole proprietorship is always faced with inadequate capital because of the small sizeof his business and his ability to source funds outside his business.

jamb-commerce-bank-1502.explanation: Called up share capital is shares issued to investors, under the understanding that the shares will be paid for at a later date or in installments.

jamb-commerce-bank-1503.explanation: An entrepreneur is the one who organizes, manages,and assumes the risks of a business or enterprise. Risk taking is one of the key elements of entrepreneurship. An entrepreneur bears all the risks associated with the activities of the business.

jamb-commerce-bank-1504.explanation: Open market operations ("OMOs") are the central bank's primary tool of monetary policy. If the central bank wants interest rates to be lower, it buys bonds. Buying bonds injects money into the money market, increasing the money supply.

jamb-commerce-bank-1505.explanation: The Nigerian Stock Exchange (NSE) oversees the organized trading in capital markets products, including stocks, mutual funds, treasury bills, and bonds. The Capital Market in Nigeria is a deregulated market which is made up of both primary and secondary markets. Primary market: this is the part of the capital market where companies raise funds through the sale of new securities, while the secondary market, on the other hand, is a platform where investors purchase and sell existing securities.

jamb-commerce-bank-1506.explanation: Dumping is considered a form of price discrimination. It occurs when a manufacturer lowers the price of an item entering a foreign market to a level that is less than the price paid by domestic customers in the originating country.

jamb-commerce-bank-1507.explanation: Wholesaling is a business activity which entails buying of goods in bulk from the producer and selling in small quantities to the retailer and other merchants.

jamb-commerce-bank-1508.explanation: A board of directors is a panel of people who are elected to represent shareholders. The board of directors of public enterprise is appointed by the government. The board of directors managed and controlled the business.

jamb-commerce-bank-1509.explanation: Cooperatives are about people having a shared sense of purpose and aligned self-interests. One-member, one-vote works great in this context because it distributes decision-making and is designed to reflect the interests of a majority of owners. For example, suppose a cooperatives proposes to purchase one of its competitors and expand the business.

jamb-commerce-bank-1510.explanation: Trade is the activity of buying and selling, or exchanging, goods and/or services between people or countries

jamb-commerce-bank-1511.explanation: The central bank serves as lender of last resort, bankers bank . The CBN issues the country's currency and facilitates foreign exchange.

jamb-commerce-bank-1512.explanation: A prospectus is a formal document required by and filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) that provides details about an investment offering to the public.

jamb-commerce-bank-1513.explanation: An excise duty is a type of tax charged on goods produced within the country excise duty is a percentage levied on manufacture, sale, or use of locally produced goods.

jamb-commerce-bank-1514.explanation: Devaluation of a currency makes imports more expensive, not cheaper, and can lead to a decrease in the standard of living as the cost of imported goods and services increases.

jamb-commerce-bank-1515.explanation: Poundage is a small fixed charge that is levied by the post office for handling the postal order.

jamb-commerce-bank-1517.explanation: A marketing mix includes multiple areas of focus as part of a comprehensive marketing plan. The term often refers to a common classification that began as the four Ps: product, price, place, and promotion.

jamb-commerce-bank-1518.explanation: Commerce links producers and consumers. Production is meant for ultimate consumption. Commerce makes possible to link producers and consumers through retailers and wholesalers and also through the aids to trade. Thus commerce creates contact between the centers of production and consumption and links them.

jamb-commerce-bank-1519.explanation: The Nigerian Export Promotion Council (NEPC) is the Federal Government of Nigeria's apex institution for the promotion, development and diversification of exports.

jamb-commerce-bank-1520.explanation: External factors of business environment refer to those factors outside the purview of the organization's control that can affect the business, its operations, profits, etc. These factors further impact the internal forces in an organization to a great extent. The effects can be positive or negative.

jamb-commerce-bank-1521.explanation: In a private company, the transfer of shares is restricted, and the number of shareholders may range from a minimum of one to maximum of fifty. Public limited -liability companies must have a minimum of seven to maximum of unlimited shareholders.

jamb-commerce-bank-1522.explanation: Consumerism is the effort or actions of consumers or individuals to protect themselves against the unfair practices of businessmen. It can also be defined as a protest against business injustices and the efforts to correct such injustices.

jamb-commerce-bank-1523.explanation: central processing unit (CPU), principal part of any digital computer system, generally composed of the main memory, control unit, and arithmetic-logic unit. It constitutes the physical heart of the entire computer system; to it is linked various peripheral equipment, including input/output devices and auxiliary storage units. In modern computers, the CPU is contained on an integrated circuit chip called a microprocessor.

jamb-commerce-bank-1524.explanation: Backwardation is a percentage paid by a person selling stock for the right of delaying its delivery.

jamb-commerce-bank-1525.explanation: An uberrimae fidei contract is a legal agreement, common to the insurance industry, requiring the highest standard of good faith during disclosure of all material facts that could influence the decision of the other party.

jamb-commerce-bank-1526.explanation: Commerce is the exchange of goods or services among two or more parties. It is the subset of business that focuses on the sale of finished or unfinished products rather than their sourcing, manufacturing, transportation, or marketing.

jamb-commerce-bank-1527.explanation: Privatization occurs when a government-owned business, operation, or property becomes owned by a private, non-government party. Privatization may also describe a transition that takes a company from being publicly traded to becoming privately held.

jamb-commerce-bank-1528.explanation: Organising involves the division of work into different sections, allocating responsibilities and authority to all components of the organisation in order to achieve the objectives

jamb-commerce-bank-1529.explanation: Warehousing is the process of storing physical inventory for sale or distribution. Warehouses are used by all different types of businesses that need to temporarily store products in bulk before either shipping them to other locations or individually to end consumers.

jamb-commerce-bank-1530.explanation: Terms of Trade (TOT) is the rate at which a country's exports exchange for its imports and it is calculated as: TOT = index of export price index of import price x

jamb-commerce-bank-1531.explanation: The scope of commerce is Trade and Aids to trade, i.e commerce is divided into trade and aids to trade.

jamb-commerce-bank-1532.explanation: It refers to several exchanges or securities such as shares, bonds, debentures etc in which shares of publicly held companies are bought and sold.

jamb-commerce-bank-1533.explanation: manufacturing occupation is concerned with the activities of those who engage in processing and turning raw materials produced in the primary industry into finished products.

jamb-commerce-bank-1534.explanation: The type of letters that are delivered through the normal mail or by airmail express service is referred to as inland letters. Inland letters are letters that are sent within the same country. They can be delivered through the normal mail service or by airmail express service, depending on the sender's preference and the urgency of the letter.

jamb-commerce-bank-1535.explanation: A quota is a government-imposed trade restriction that limits the number or monetary value of goods that a country can import or export during a particular period. Countries use quotas in international trade to help regulate the volume of trade between them and other countries.

jamb-commerce-bank-1536.explanation: Air transport are the fastest and most efficient means of transportation. It is comfortable and offers quality service. The ease of travelling over long distances in comfort are almost entirely due to air transport.

jamb-commerce-bank-1537.explanation: A redeemable bond is a government bond which has no date of maturity and which therefore provides interest but can never be redeemed at full value.

jamb-commerce-bank-1538.explanation: The Verbal Communication is a type of oral communication wherein the message is transmitted through the spoken words. Here the sender gives words to his feelings, thoughts, ideas and opinions and expresses them in the form of speeches, discussions, presentations, and conversations. It includes face to face conversation, phone calls, interview etc.

jamb-commerce-bank-1539.explanation: The marketing mix, also known as the 4Ps of marketing, includes Product, Price, Place, and Promotion. Therefore, 'promotion' is an item in the marketing mix. The other options, demand, market, and consumer, are not part of the marketing mix but are factors that influence marketing strategies.

jamb-commerce-bank-1540.explanation: The sources of finance are: - hire purchase - trade credit - loans and overdraft - sales of shares - sales of debentures - bill of exchange - retained profits

jamb-commerce-bank-1541.explanation: The Trade description Act was introduced to prevent the deception of consumers by false advertising. The provisions are meant to protect consumers against misleading description of goods and services.

jamb-commerce-bank-1542.explanation: SEC is in charge of regulating funding schemes across Nigeria. From public funding to crowdfunding schemes, SEC is a significant agency to interrelate with before such schemes can be undertaken by companies in Nigeria.

jamb-commerce-bank-1543.explanation: A clean bill of lading is a type of ocean bill of lading. It is a transport document that indicates that the goods received in the vessel are in good condition and free from any defect.

jamb-commerce-bank-1546.explanation: When a bill of exchange is sold for less than its face value before its maturity date, it is referred to as being discounted. This discount represents the difference between the face value of the bill and the amount received by the holder of the bill when selling it before maturity. The discounted amount is usually determined based on the remaining time to maturity and prevailing interest rates.

jamb-commerce-bank-1547.explanation: When all parties to a contract have fulfilled their obligations as stated in the contract, the contract is considered to be terminated by performance. Performance refers to the complete and satisfactory fulfillment of the terms, conditions, an obligations outlined in the contract by all parties involved. Once performance is achieved, the contract is considered to be fully executed and no longer in effect.

jamb-commerce-bank-1548.explanation: A speculator who buys securities with the intention of reselling them at a high price. If the price falls, he loses and has the option to carry forward the transaction to the next settlement by paying a charge termed "Contango".

jamb-commerce-bank-1549.explanation: A holding company is a company that owns a significant portion of the voting shares or equity of another company, known as its subsidiary. To be considered a holding company, it typically needs to hold a majority of the voting rights or shares of the subsidiary, which is generally defined as owning more than 51% of the subsidiary's shares.

jamb-commerce-bank-1550.explanation: A multiple shop, also known as a chain store or a retail chain, is a business that operates multiple retail stores under the same brand or company. These stores typically sell similar goods or products across different locations. The purpose of multiple shop is to provide consistent offerings and branding to customers across various outlets.

jamb-commerce-bank-1551.explanation: A sole trader, also known as a sole proprietor or sole proprietorship, is an individual who owns and operates a business independently. As a sole trader, the person is solely responsible for the business's profits, losses, and liabilities. They hav full control over the business's operations and make all decisions independently.

jamb-commerce-bank-1552.explanation: In a public limited liability company, ownership is held by the shareholders. Shareholders are individuals or entities that hold shares or ownership interests in the company. They are the owners of the company and have rights and privileges associated with their shareholdings, such as voting rights, dividend entitlement, and the ability to participate in decision making processes

jamb-commerce-bank-1553.explanation: A tramp ship is a type of cargo ship that operates on the tramp trade. Tramp ships do not have fixed routes or schedules like liners. Instead, they move from port to port based on market demand and available cargoes. Tramp ships are typically chartered by cargo owners or shipping agents for transporting goods on an ad-hoc basis. They provide flexible transportation options for various types of cargo and destinations.

jamb-commerce-bank-1554.explanation: Excise duty is a type of tax levied on specific goods produced or consumed within a country. It is typically imposed on goods such as alcohol, tobacco, petroleum products, and certain luxury items. Excise duty is usually included in the price of the goods and is paid by the manufacturer or producer, who then passes on the cost to the consumer.

jamb-commerce-bank-1555.explanation: In an unlimited partnership, all partners have unlimited personal liability for the debts and obligations of the partnership. This means that if the partnership is unable to meet its financial obligations, the partners' personal assets can be used to satisfy those debts. Additionally, in an unlimited partnership, all partners have an equal say in the management and decision-making of the business.

jamb-commerce-bank-1556.explanation: Assurance policies, commonly known as life insurance policies, provide financial protection to the policyholder's beneficiaries in the event of their death. Upon the death of the insured person, the policy pays out a predetermined sum of money to the designated beneficiaries. This payout is intended to provide financial support to the family or dependents of the deceased.

jamb-commerce-bank-1557.explanation: A factor is a type of wholesaler or intermediary who acts as an agent on behalf of the owner of the goods. The factor assists in the buying and selling of goods, typically in large quantities, and earns a commission based on the value of the transaction. Factors primarily operate in the field of financing and trade, providing services such as inventory management, credit assessment, and collection of accounts receivable.

jamb-commerce-bank-1558.explanation: Particular average is not one of the principles of insurance. It refers to a type of partial loss that occurs when a specific item or interest is damaged or lost, and the loss is borne by the owner of that particular item or interest, rather than being spread across all parties insured.

jamb-commerce-bank-1559.explanation: A del-credere agent is a type of agent who guarantees or assumes responsibility for the payment of goods or services by customers to the principal. In other words, if the customer fails to pay for the goods purchased, the del-credere agent becomes liable for the payment to the principal. This additional liability is typically compensated by the del-credere agent through a higher commission or fee.

jamb-commerce-bank-1560.explanation: A contract is a legally binding agreement between two or more parties that creates obligations that are enforceable by law. For a contract to be valid, it typically requires an offer, acceptance, consideration (something of value exchanged between the parties), legal capacity of the parties, and a lawful purpose. Once all the necessary elements are present, a contract is formed, and the parties involved are legally obligated to fulfill their respective obligations as outlined in the agreement.

jamb-commerce-bank-1561.explanation: A cash discount refers to a reduction in the price or amount owed by a customer for making prompt payment. It is a financial incentive offered by the seller to encourage customers to pay their invoices or bills within a specified time frame. By offering a cash discount, the seller aims to

jamb-commerce-bank-1562.explanation: In a public limited liability company, ownership is held by the shareholders. Shareholders are individuals or entities that hold shares or ownership interests in the company. They are the owners of the company and have rights and privileges associated with their shareholdings, such as voting rights, dividend entitlement, and the ability to participate in decision making processes

jamb-commerce-bank-1563.explanation: A current account, also known as a checking account, is a type of bank account that allows frequent transactions, including writing cheques. Cheque books are commonly provided to customers with current accounts to facilitate payments and withdrawals

jamb-commerce-bank-1564.explanation: A bonded warehouse is a secured facility where goods are stored under the supervision and control of customs authorities. It is a facility authorized by the government where imported goods can be stored before they are cleared through customs and released into the local market. The purpose of a bonded warehouse is to provide a secure storage location for goods while customs duties, taxes, or other regulatory requirements are being addressed.

jamb-commerce-bank-1565.explanation: Branding involves the creation and application of distinctive trade marks (such as logos, names, symbols, or slogans) to goods or services. The primary purpose of branding is to enable the identification and differentiation of products or services from competitors in the marketplace. By associating specific trade marks with goods, branding helps consumer identify and recognize a particular product or service, thereby distinguishing it from others. Effective branding can create a unique and recognizable identity for a product or company, contributing to brand loyalty and influencing consumer pu

jamb-commerce-bank-1566.explanation: Closing stock refers to the value of inventory or goods that are still available for sale at the end of an accounting period. It represents the stock that remains unsold and is carried forward to the next accounting period. The term "closing stock" is used because it is the final inventory balance recorded at the close or end of the period

jamb-commerce-bank-1567.explanation: Large-scale retailers are businesses that engage in the sale of goods directly to consumers in significant quantities. They typically operate multiple outlets or stores, have a wide range of products, and offer various services to customers. Departmental stores, supermarkets, and chain stores are all examples of large-scale retailers that serve a significant customer base and offer a diverse selection of products in a retail setting.

jamb-commerce-bank-1568.explanation: The extractive industry involves the extraction or removal of natural resources from the earth or sea. Fishing is a primary example of an extractive industry as it involves the harvesting of fish and other seafood from natural water sources such as oceans, rivers, and lakes.

jamb-commerce-bank-1571.explanation: Ordinary shareholders have the lowest priority in the distribution of assets during the winding up of a company. They ar entitled to receive any remaining assets after all the other creditors and obligations have been satisfied. Preference shareholders, debenture holders, and trade creditors would typically have higher priority for payment than ordinary shareholders

jamb-commerce-bank-1572.explanation: When a cheque is stolen, it is crucial to take immediate action to prevent any unauthorized transactions. By informing his bank to stop payment on the stolen cheque, Obi can protect himself from any potential financial loss or fraudulent activity. The bank can then put a stop payment order on the cheque, ensuring that it cannot be cashed or processed.

jamb-commerce-bank-1573.explanation: Transporting petroleum products through pipelines is a common and efficient method. Pipelines provide a reliable and cost-effective means of transporting large volumes of petroleum products over long distances. They are designed to transport liquids, including crude oil and refined petroleum products, through a network of interconnected pipes. Pipelines offer advantages such as high capacity, continuous flow, reduced handling, and lower transportation costs compared to other means of transportation.

jamb-commerce-bank-1574.explanation: Carpentry is a skilled trade or craft that involves working with wood to construct, install, or repair structures or objects While carpentry may involve using materials derived from natural resources, it is not directly related to the primary extraction or production of those resources. Therefore, carpentry does not fit into the group of industries related to agriculture, fishing, mining, and quarrying.

jamb-commerce-bank-1575.explanation: A prospectus is a formal document issued by a company seeking to raise capital through the sale of shares to the public. It provides detailed information about the company, its operations, financial, risks, and the terms of the offering. The prospectus serves as an invitation to potential investors to buy shares in the company

jamb-commerce-bank-1576.explanation: When shares are sold at a discount, it means that the selling price of the shares is lower than their par value. The par value is the nominal value assigned to each share by the company at the time of its incorporation. Selling shares below par value can happen for various reasons, such as market conditions, financial considerations, or to attract investors.

jamb-commerce-bank-1577.explanation: Tramp ships, also known as tramp steamers, are cargo vessels that do not have fixed schedules or routes. They operate o an "as-needed" basis, picking up cargo from any port where there is a demand and traveling at any time as required. Tramp ships are flexible in terms of their destinations and timing, allowing them to transport cargo to various locations based on market conditions and specific shipping requirements.

jamb-commerce-bank-1578.explanation: When shares are quoted at a price higher than their par value or initial offering price, it is considered a premium. In this case, the quoted price of #1.25K per share is higher than the par value or the original offering price, which indicates that the shares were sold at a premium

jamb-commerce-bank-1579.explanation: A tariff is a tax or duty imposed by a government on goods that are imported into a country. It is a form of trade barrier that increases the cost of imported products, making them less competitive compared to domestically produced goods. Tariffs are typically levied on specific goods or categories of goods and are collected at the border when the goods enter the country.

jamb-commerce-bank-1580.explanation: The Nigeria Enterprises Promotion Decree, also known as the Nigerian Indigenization Decree, was enacted in 1972. It aimed to promote the participation and ownership of Nigerians in the country's economic activities by requiring a minimum level of Nigerian equity participation in certain industries and businesses. This policy was implemented as part of Nigeria's broader efforts towards indigenization, which sought to increase local control and ownership of businesses and reduce the dominance of foreign-owned companies.

jamb-commerce-bank-1581.explanation: Specialization refers to the process where individuals or organizations focus on a specific area of expertise or a particular task. It involves dedicating time, effort, and resources to develop specialized skills and knowledge in a particular field or job. By specializing, individuals or organizations aim to become more efficient and productive in their chosen area, as they can focus on developing expertise and improving their performance in that specific domain.

jamb-commerce-bank-1582.explanation: Manufacturing refers to the process of transforming raw materials or components into finished goods through various production activities such as processing, assembling, fabricating, or refining. It involves the conversion of inputs into tangible products or goods that are ready for distribution and sale.

jamb-commerce-bank-1583.explanation: Neon signs are advertising signs that use electric current in bulbs filled with neon gas or other gases to create bright anċ vibrant displays. The electric current passes through the gas-filled tubes, causing them to emit light of various colors. Neon signs are commonly used for outdoor advertising on buildings, storefronts, and billboards to attract attention and promote businesses or products.

jamb-commerce-bank-1584.explanation: Communication plays a vital role in enabling producers and consumers to interact, exchange information, and conduct business without the need for physical contact. Through various means of communication, such as telephone, email, online platforms, and other digital channels, producers and consumers can communicate and engage in business transactions remotely.

jamb-commerce-bank-1585.explanation: A credit and thrift co-operative society is an organization that promotes savings and provides credit facilities to its members. It operates on the principle of pooling members' savings and using those funds to offer loans and other financial services to the members. The primary objective of a credit and thrift co-operative society is to encourage thrift and savings among its members and provide them access to affordable credit.

jamb-commerce-bank-1586.explanation: The Nigerian Standards Organization, also known as the Standards Organization of Nigeria (SON), is the body in Nigeria that is responsible for the development and enforcement of standards for goods, products, and services. It ensures that the quality of goods supplied in Nigeria meets the required standards and specifications.

jamb-commerce-bank-1587.explanation: Division of labour refers to the practice of breaking down a complex task or job into smaller, specialized tasks or processes. Each individual or group focuses on performing a specific task or process, which leads to increased efficiency and productivity. This concept was popularized by the economist Adam Smith in his book "The Wealth of Nations" and i widely used in various industries and organizations.

jamb-commerce-bank-1588.explanation: Amalgamation refers to the process of combining two or more companies into a single entity, where the individual firms lose their separate identities and form a new entity. In an amalgamation, the combining firms merge their assets, liabilities, and operations to create a new company. This new company assumes the rights and obligations of the merged entities, and the original companies cease to exist as independent entities.

jamb-commerce-bank-1589.explanation: The balance of payments (BOP) is a record of all economic transactions between residents of one country and residents of other countries over a specific period. It is divided into three main components, which are: Current, Capital and Monetary movement (financial) account.

jamb-commerce-bank-1590.explanation: In maritime law, a general average loss refers to a situation where sacrifices or expenses are intentionally incurred to preserve the common maritime adventure. When a ship is in peril, and goods or cargo are thrown overboard as a deliberate act to save the ship and the remaining cargo, it is considered a general average loss. The loss or damage is shared proportionally among the shipowner, cargo owners, and other parties involved in the maritime venture

jamb-commerce-bank-1591.explanation: This represented the profit a jobber earned by buying from a seller at a lower price (bid) and then selling to a buyer at a higher price (ask). This spread compensated the jobber for taking on the risk of holding inventory (shares) and facilitating trades.

jamb-commerce-bank-1592.explanation: An invoice is a document provided by a seller to a buyer that outlines the details of a transaction, including the goods or services sold, quantities, prices, payment terms, and any applicable taxes or fees. It serves as a formal request for payment and provides complete information about the goods or services purchased. The invoice is typically sent to the buyer after the goods have been delivered or the services have been rendered.

jamb-commerce-bank-1593.explanation: An invoice is a document sent by a supplier to a buyer that provides detailed information about a sale transaction. It includes the quantity, description, and price of the goods or services being sold, as well as any applicable taxes, discount or additional charges. An invoice serves as a request for payment from the buyer and provides the buyer with the necessary information to make a payment for the goods or services received or to be received.

jamb-commerce-bank-1594.explanation: The Nigerian Enterprises Promotion Decree of 1973, also known as the Indigenization Decree, was a significant policy implemented by the Nigerian government aimed at promoting indigenous participation and ownership in the country's economy. The decree outlined provisions for the transfer of ownership and control of certain businesses from foreign owners to Nigerian citizens.

jamb-commerce-bank-1595.explanation: Marketing involves various activities aimed at promoting and selling products or services to customers. It encompasses a wide range of functions and processes to create, communicate, and deliver value to customers. However, insurance is not typically considered a direct function of marketing. Insurance is a separate industry that provides risk management and financial protection services, which are not directly related to the core functions of marketing.

jamb-commerce-bank-1598.explanation: Nationalization refers to the process by which the government takes ownership and control of private industries or assets. The primary objective of nationalization is to transfer the ownership and control of key industries from private entities to the government. This allows the government to exercise influence over the industry's operations, strategic decision-making, and resource allocation. Nationalization is often driven by the government's desire to safeguard national interests, promote public welfare, ensure economic stability, or pursue specific policy objectives.

jamb-commerce-bank-1599.explanation: Indigenization refers to a policy or set of measures aimed at promoting and increasing the participation of indigenous people, in this case, Nigerians, in the ownership and management of businesses within their country. It involves creating opportunities, providing incentives, and implementing regulations to ensure that a significant portion of the economy is controlled by Nigerian citizens.

jamb-commerce-bank-1600.explanation: The principle of indemnity in insurance states that the insured should be compensated for the actual financial loss suffered due to an insured event, up to the extent of the policy coverage. The purpose of indemnity is to place the insure in the same financial position as they were before the loss occurred, without making a profit from the insurance claim. With indemnity, the insured is not allowed to gain financially from the insurance policy but is entitled to receive compensation that helps restore them to their pre-loss condition. The compensation is typically based on the actual value of

jamb-commerce-bank-1601.explanation: The balance of trade is a measure of the difference between the value of a country's visible exports (goods and services sold to other countries) and visible imports (goods and services purchased from other countries) over a specific period, usually a trading year. It provides insight into the economic relationship between a country and its trading partners. The balance of trade can be positive (surplus) if the value of exports exceeds imports, indicating that a country is exporting more than it is importing. Conversely, it can be negative (deficit) if imports exceed exports, indicating that a

jamb-commerce-bank-1602.explanation: The rights of consumers are a set of principles and protections that aim to ensure fair treatment and satisfactory experiences in the marketplace. These rights are recognized and promoted by consumer protection laws and organizations.

jamb-commerce-bank-1603.explanation: Commercial law, also referred to as business law or mercantile law, encompasses the legal principles and regulations tha govern business and commercial transactions. It provides a framework for conducting business activities, regulating contracts, resolving disputes, and ensuring fair practices in the business environment.

jamb-commerce-bank-1604.explanation: The Free post service allows individuals to send letters or parcels to any post office without the need to pay for postage upfront. The addressee can then collect the item from the designated post office upon presentation of proper identification.

jamb-commerce-bank-1605.explanation: A premium is the amount of money that an individual or entity pays to an insurance company in exchange for insurance coverage. It is typically paid periodically, such as monthly, quarterly, or annually, depending on the terms of the insurance policy. The premium is determined based on various factors, including the type of insurance, the coverage amount, the risk profile of the insured, and other relevant factors. By paying the premium, the insured obtains the benefits and protection outlined in the insurance policy.

jamb-commerce-bank-1606.explanation: "Caveat emptor" is a Latin phrase that translates to "let the buyer beware" in English. It represents the principle that places the responsibility on the buyer to carefully examine and assess the quality, condition, and suitability of a product or service before making a purchase. It suggests that the buyer should be cautious and aware of any potential risks or defects associated with the product, as the seller may not be obligated to disclose all relevant information.

jamb-commerce-bank-1607.explanation: Consumer sovereignty is an economic concept that emphasizes the power and authority of consumers in determining what goods and services are produced and offered in the market. It implies that consumer preferences and choices ultimately dictate the production and availability of products. In a market economy, producers and businesses respond t consumer demand and strive to satisfy consumer preferences to maximize their own profits. By referring to the consumer as a "king," the term highlights the idea that consumers have the power to make decisions and influence the market. It suggests that con

jamb-commerce-bank-1608.explanation: In a Hire Purchase System, the buyer agrees to make a series of payments or installments over a specified period to the seller or financing entity. The buyer has possession of the goods during the payment period but does not have legal ownership until the final payment is made. Once the final installment is paid, the ownership of the goods is transferred t the buyer, and they become the legal owner.

jamb-commerce-bank-1609.explanation: Consideration refers to something of value that is given in exchange for a product, service, or promise. In this case, the # 2,000.00 paid by Halima to Aisha represents the consideration for the purchase of the wristwatch. It is the price or payment that is given by the buyer in exchange for the item being sold.

jamb-commerce-bank-1610.explanation: The term "franco" or "franco destination" indicates that the seller is responsible for all shipping and delivery costs associated with transporting the goods from their warehouse to the buyer's warehouse. It means that the price quoted includes the cost of carriage, insurance, and any other charges required to deliver the goods to the specified destination.

jamb-commerce-bank-1611.explanation: Possession, as a standalone term, is not a specific area of law commonly associated with business law. Possession generally refers to the physical control or ownership of property or assets, but it is not a distinct legal area in the same way as agency, contract, hire purchase, or sale of goods

jamb-commerce-bank-1612.explanation: Vending machines are automated machines that dispense a variety of products to customers. They are commonly used t sell snacks, beverages, and other small items that are pre-packaged and can be easily dispensed.

jamb-commerce-bank-1613.explanation: Magazines are a form of advertising media that preselects its readership through the nature of its content. Magazines typically cater to specific interests, hobbies, industries, or demographics. They offer specialized content that attracts a particular target audience. Advertisers often choose to place their ads in magazines that align with their target market t ensure their message reaches the desired audience. By selecting magazines with content relevant to their products or services, advertisers can effectively reach a preselected readership likely to have an interest in their offerings.

jamb-commerce-bank-1614.explanation: A bill of lading is a document issued by a carrier or shipping company to acknowledge the receipt of goods for shipment It serves as evidence of the contract of carriage and provides details such as the description of the goods, the names of the shipper and the consignee, the destination, and the terms of shipment. A bill of lading acts as a receipt for the goods and also serves as a document of title, which means it can be used to establish the importer's ownership or right to possess the goods

jamb-commerce-bank-1615.explanation: A letter of inquiry is a communication from a potential buyer to a seller, expressing interest in obtaining information about a specific product, service, or pricing. In response to this inquiry, the seller would usually provide a quotation. A quotation is a formal document that outlines the details of the products or services requested by the buyer, including prices, quantities, terms and conditions, and any other relevant information.

jamb-commerce-bank-1616.explanation: The name of the company is an essential component of the Articles of Association. It specifies the legal name under which the company operates and is registered.

jamb-commerce-bank-1617.explanation: A bill of lading is a document issued by a carrier (such as a shipping company) to acknowledge the receipt of goods and provide evidence of the contract of carriage. It serves as a receipt for the goods being transported and contains information about the shipment, such as the type of goods, quantity, and destination. However, a bill of lading is not considered a credit instrument.

jamb-commerce-bank-1618.explanation: Advertising is a promotional activity aimed at reaching a target audience and influencing their behavior or perception. I serves various purposes and aims to achieve specific goals.

jamb-commerce-bank-1619.explanation: Pre-sales services are the activities and support provided to potential buyers before the actual sale takes place. These services aim to assist customers in making informed purchasing decisions and to facilitate a smooth sales process. They typically include activities such as providing information about the products, answering inquiries, and assisting with product selection. However, granting credit or hire purchase sales facilities is not typically considered a pre-sales service.

jamb-commerce-bank-1620.explanation: Personnel, which refers to the individuals or employees involved in the marketing and sales process, is not typically considered one of the elements of the marketing mix. While personnel play a crucial role in delivering the marketing message and providing customer service, they are not one of the core components of the marketing mix concept. The marketing mix are: price, place, product and place which are also known as the 4P's of marketing.

jamb-commerce-bank-1621.explanation: Welfare services in an organization typically refer to the initiatives and benefits provided to employees to enhance their well-being and quality of life. They are designed to support employees beyond their regular compensation and foster a positive work environment.

jamb-commerce-bank-1622.explanation: NITEL was the national telecommunications company of Nigeria. While it provided various telecommunications services, including telephone services, data transmission, satellite communications, and telex services, it did not offer recorded delivery services.

jamb-commerce-bank-1623.explanation: The principle of indemnity in insurance refers to the principle that an insured party should be compensated for the actual financial loss suffered, up to the limit of the policy coverage. The purpose is to restore the insured to the same financial position they were in before the loss occurred. While most types of insurance, including fidelity guarantee, fire, marine, and motor vehicle insurance, typically operate based on the principle of indemnity, life insurance is an exception. Life insurance is not based on indemnity because it involves the payment of a predetermined sum (death benefit) u

jamb-commerce-bank-1624.explanation: A bonded warehouse is a type of warehouse that is located near a port or customs entry point. It is specifically designed and authorized by the government to store imported goods before they are cleared by customs and released for distribution or sale in the local market. Bonded warehouses provide storage facilities for goods on which customs duties and taxes have not yet been paid.

jamb-commerce-bank-1625.explanation: Privatization and commercialization are not specific legislation enacted by governments to protect consumers. Instead, they are policies or strategies related to the ownership and operation of industries and services. Privatization involves transferring ownership or control of government-owned assets or enterprises to private entities, while commercialization refers to making an activity or service more commercial or profit-oriented.

jamb-commerce-bank-1626.explanation: Working capital is the measure of a company's short-term liquidity and its ability to cover its day-to-day operational expenses. It is calculated by subtracting current liabilities from current assets. Current assets include items that are expected to be converted into cash within one year or the operating cycle of the business, whichever is longer.
